reasons.claim: Notified regeneration felling, polygon 15.27 ha, status notified; completed felling overlaps only 0.6% of polygon.

One eligible species, Alectoria sarmentosa (garnlav, VU, lichen, site-bound, forest-associated; felling-relevant threats include lack of continuity forest and of large/old trees), recorded 2025, 6 m from the polygon edge with 10 m uncertainty.
Overall recording effort is low (2 records within 1000 m, 10th percentile vs county median 27), so the single record is notable but the area is thinly surveyed.

uncertainties: Single record from one observation day; does not show the lichen occupies the felling area today.
Low effort means other species could be unrecorded.
not_established: Presence or absence of the species inside the stand to be felled
Forest condition or biodiversity of the site
next_action: Human reviewer should check the 2025 garnlav record location against the polygon and consider a field inventory before felling starts.
